flyer-2024-prayer-conference.alt: Flyer for the 8th Annual Prayer Conference, October 24 to 26, 2024, 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM, at 90 Herndon Lane, Canton, GA 30114. Free parking and free event.

flyer-2023-prayer-conference.alt: Flyer for the 7th Annual America Back to God Prayer Conference, November 9 to 11, 2023, 6PM to 9PM, at 1075 Holcomb Bridge Rd, Roswell, GA 30076.

flyer-monthly-prayer-meeting.alt: Flyer for the monthly prayer meeting on the first Friday of every month. Dinner 6:00 to 7:00 PM, worship and prayer 7:00 to 8:30 PM. Free food, free prayer, free admission, at 380 Grayson Way, Alpharetta, GA 30004.
